title: Урок для Сени и пропавшая тысяча  (A Lesson for Senya and the Missing Thousand)

segments.t: At the bar, when Senya assumes everyone will split the bill for the expensive cognac, the cooks remind him that he invited them and force him to hand over his entire paycheck as a lesson against stealing food. Moments later, Chef Barinov counts his cash and realizes a thousand-ruble note is missing.
А мы скидываемся только в том случае.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
А мы скидываемся только в том случае.
'We only chip in together in one case.' Notice how Russian puts 'are chipping in' and 'case, event' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'When we go to the sauna as a team.' The grammar packs 'when' and 'team' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'And today is a completely different case.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'case'.
'You were the one who invited us.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'us' in a few short words. Senya answers right away.
'My entire paycheck is right here.' The meaning hinges on 'here' working together with 'salary' in spoken Russian.
'That will teach you a lesson.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'this' before landing on 'lesson'.
'Next time you will not go grabbing other people's food.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'nonsense' and finishing on 'someone else's'. Fedya answers right away.
'That is just how it goes in life.' In Russian, the idea of 'there you go' flows naturally into 'life' without extra filler words.
'You bend over backward trying your hardest.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'climb' before landing on 'out'.
'Wait, I do not get it.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'understood?' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Senya answers right away.
'Where is the money?' In everyday Russian, 'where' flows straight into 'money' without extra linking words.
'There is a thousand rubles missing in here.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'but' and 'there' in a few short words.
'Hurry up, people are waiting out there.' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'are waiting' in spoken Russian. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
А мы скидываемся только в том случае.

That wraps up this scene as the cooks force Senya to pay the bar bill with his entire salary as punishment for stealing food, while Chef Barinov discovers a thousand rubles missing from his office stash. Until next time!
